text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that a festival was being held in a nearby town,
I decided to check it out while going out with Inari One.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, now this is lively!
A festival's just gotta be like this!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? Is that—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I knew it was you, Oguri!
Didn't expect to see you here too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I caught a delicious smell, so I just kept running and running until I ended up here.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that sounds just like you.
In that case, what do ya say—
wanna go check out the food stalls together?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I was just about to head out
for my second lap.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: You were already doing it?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with Oguri Cap joining us,
the three of us went around the festival together, but—

text_block_list.name: Festival Organizer A
text_block_list.text: “—Whaaat!? We can't bring out the portable shrine!?”

text_block_list.name: Festival Organizer B
text_block_list.text:
What are you gonna do about this?!
Everyone's sick of waiting!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hmm...? What's this, a fight?

text_block_list.name: Festival Organizer A
text_block_list.text:
—And so, there's a small fire nearby right now.
The folks who were s'posed to carry the mikoshi
ran off to help put it out.

text_block_list.name: Festival Organizer B
text_block_list.text: At this rate, the audience who came to watch will just leave... Oh, I know! You girls might be able to—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, you don't gotta say another word.
You want us Umamusume to lend a hand carrying the portable shrine, don'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Festival Organizer B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Sorry, but knowing it's a big ask, I still gotta ask ya.
What do ya say...?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...No. As much as I'd love to carry you on my shoulders,
I'm gonna have to go with a different approach here."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, as great as Lady Inari is, she can't do
it all alone. Trainer, Oguri, I'm gonna need
you guys to lend a hand, too."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: “—Roll up, roll up, ladies and gents! Don't you dare miss it! The showdown of the century is about to begin!”

text_block_list.name: Festival Visitor
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's that? What's with that massive pile
of yakisoba and takoyaki...!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Gracing us here is the renowned gluttonous champion, Oguri Cap!
The one and only Big Eater Yokai!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm the Great Stomach Monster. Nice to meetcha.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The one challenging the champion is none other than Inari One!
Let's see who can finish off this mountain of food piled high as Mt. Fuji first!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Here we go! Ready... Start!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the help of festival stalls and local shops,
we managed to pull off an impromptu eating contest.
The crowd was thrilled, and then—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Oh! Look at that, the headliner's finally making their entrance!

text_block_list.name: Mikoshi Bearers
text_block_list.text: —*Seiya! Seiya!*

text_block_list.name: Festival Visitors
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa! It's here, the portable shrine!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. That heat's fierce enough to reach the heavens, ain't it?
...Well then, guess it's about time I made my exit.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
What? Are you done already?
Things haven't been settled yet, though...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Our role was just the sideshow before the main event.
That's all for our helper duties!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Look at 'em—the folks carrying the mikoshi.
And look at the sparkling, shining eyes of the crowd watching them.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: No sense in getting weirdly competitive and spoiling the mood! Right, let's pack up the leftover food and get a move on.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Phew~. Still, once everything was taken care of,
all the exhaustion hit me at once.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, we saved face for the other side and bought some time.
I'd say that's a pretty great outcome, wouldn't you?
choice_data_list: I wanted to settle our eating contest, too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, we saved face for the other side and bought some time.
I'd say that's a pretty great outcome, wouldn't you?
choice_data_list: I wanted to settle our eating contest, too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
No. Those words are what
I should be saying to the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: After all, Oguri put on a great show with her eating. Well, might just be business as usual for you, though.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Besides... the one who ran around all over the place to arrange all that food... was the Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Really now... Before I knew it,
you've turned into someone truly dependable too, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, thanks to the stylish trio's heroic efforts, the festival was saved from disaster.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on now. You want me to go toe-to-toe
with Oguri? That's asking a bit much, don't you think—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. We brought back the rest from earlier,
so shall we get right back to it?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... You're all fired up, huh?
Well, Lady Inari ain't about to
turn tail and run from that...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Aargh, dammit all! I'll do it!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And though Inari One challenged it with all her Edokko pride...
she was utterly crushed before the monster's bottomless stomach.
